meta.title: SF Late Night
meta.origin: 21st Ave & Judah St, San Francisco, CA 94122
meta.threshold: Open past 11:00 PM on Friday, Saturday, or Sunday
meta.scopeNote: Static, source-linked directory of 20 verified records. It does not claim every San Francisco business is open or available; expand the master list only after a line-by-line source check.
meta.transitNote: Transit labels are screening notes, not turn-by-turn directions. Use the live route link and check SFMTA/BART service before leaving.

transit.originNote: From 21st Ave & Judah St, the closest useful N Judah boarding point is around Judah St & 19th Ave; a live planner is still required for the final walk, transfers, and disruptions.

lines.name: N Judah
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday: 12 min morning, midday, and evening; 20 min late night; Owl 30 min.
lines.nightCoverage: SFMTA points riders to the N Bus between subway hours and Owl service.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists N Judah as 24 hours daily. Its weekend frequency row lists 12 minutes in morning, midday, and evening, 20 minutes late night, and 30-minute Owl service.

lines.name: 5 Fulton
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday: 7 min morning and midday; 12 min evening; 20 min late night; Owl 30 min.
lines.nightCoverage: SFMTA says weekend service runs Ocean Beach–Downtown 5 AM–midnight, with 5 Owl from midnight–5 AM.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 5 Fulton as 24 hours daily. The weekend frequency row lists 7 minutes morning and midday, 12 minutes evening, 20 minutes late night, and 30-minute Owl service.

lines.name: 14 Mission
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday: 8 min morning and midday; 10 min evening; 15 min late night and Owl.
lines.nightCoverage: The route page lists Owl service as part of the 14 schedule.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 14 Mission as 24 hours daily. Its weekend frequency row lists 8 minutes morning and midday, 10 minutes evening, and 15 minutes late night and Owl.

lines.name: 22 Fillmore
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday: 10 min morning; 8 min midday and evening; 15 min late night; Owl 30 min.
lines.nightCoverage: SFMTA lists Owl service on the 22 Fillmore page.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 22 Fillmore as 24 hours daily. Its weekend frequency row lists 10 minutes morning, 8 minutes midday and evening, 15 minutes late night, and 30-minute Owl service.

lines.name: 24 Divisadero
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday: 12 min morning, midday, and evening; 20 min late night; Owl 30 min.
lines.nightCoverage: SFMTA lists Owl service on the 24 Divisadero page.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 24 Divisadero as 24 hours daily. Its weekend frequency row lists 12 minutes morning, midday, and evening, 20 minutes late night, and 30-minute Owl service.

lines.name: 30 Stockton
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday long route: 20 min morning; 15 min midday and evening; 20 min late night. Short route differs.
lines.nightCoverage: SFMTA points riders to 91 Owl for overnight service.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 30 Stockton as weekdays 5 AM–12 AM and weekends 6 AM–12 AM. The weekend long-route frequency row lists 20, 15, 15, and 20 minutes across the service periods.

lines.name: 33 Ashbury/18th Street
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday: 30 min morning; 20 min midday and evening; no late-night or Owl service listed.
lines.nightCoverage: No late-night service is listed on the official route page; do not use it as the return leg after 10 PM.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 33 Ashbury/18th Street as 5 AM–10 PM daily. Its weekend row lists 30 minutes morning, 20 minutes midday and evening, and no late-night or Owl service.

lines.name: 38 Geary
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday varies by segment: 20/20/20/20 min west of Geary & 32nd; 15/10/10/15 min east; Owl 30 min.
lines.nightCoverage: SFMTA lists Owl service on the 38 Geary page.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 38 Geary as 24 hours daily. Its weekend frequency rows vary by segment and list Owl service every 30 minutes.

lines.name: 49 Van Ness/Mission
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday: 8 min morning, midday, and evening; 13 min late night.
lines.nightCoverage: SFMTA lists Owl alternatives 14 and 90; the 49 itself is not listed as an Owl route.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 49 Van Ness/Mission as 5 AM–12 AM daily. Its weekend frequency row lists 8 minutes morning, midday, and evening, and 13 minutes late night.

lines.name: T Third Street
lines.todayFrequency: Saturday: 12 min morning, midday, and evening; 20 min late night; Owl 30 min.
lines.nightCoverage: For the early morning gap, SFMTA points to the T Bus and 91 Owl; T Bus has weekend 5–8 AM service plus late-night northbound trips.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists T Third Street as weekdays 6 AM–12 AM and weekends 8 AM–12 AM. Its weekend frequency row lists 12 minutes morning, midday, and evening, 20 minutes late night, and 91 Owl service.

lines.name: 91 3rd Street/19th Avenue Owl
lines.nightCoverage: This is the overnight alternative listed from the T and 30 route pages.
lines.sourceQuote: SFMTA lists 91 3rd Street/19th Avenue Owl as 12 AM–5 AM nightly, with 30-minute weekend late-night and Owl service.
